LESSON: COMMON

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING
Topic 2.1: Common

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Common. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Enjoy responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship in and out of school. greetings and farewell with reference to relationship using verbal and non-verbal language. to respond to visitors’ greetings and farewell with reference to relationship using appropriate words. encouraged to respond to visitors and family members’ greetings and farewell at home with reference to relationship using appropriate words. recorded clips on responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship and imitate the same. 3 responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship. interactive songs related to responding to greetings and farewell with reference to relationship. SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Common.
2. Explain Common to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Common.
4. 5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Common. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Common important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
